feedback: The exposed branch does not encode the universal requirement. Each qualifiedMinCount 1 only requires at least one conforming protected item of each category, so additional escape routes, muster stations, embarkation areas, survival crafts, launching appliances, or access routes lacking means can pass. It also incorrectly makes all six categories existentially mandatory; a universal every-item rule does not imply minCount 1. Replace these qualified constraints with a universal sh:node constraint on every nltl:hasProtectedItem value, using an item shape that requires the controlled category alternative and sh:minCount 1 on nltl:hasIceSnowRemovalOrPreventionMeans. Retain category existence only if independently required by the verified requirement.
